_doc: PLANTEUR bg8void taxonomy. Maps the 26-class source label id to the 8 trained classes; every excluded crop -> 255 (void), masked out of loss and metrics. Background(0) stays a real trained class. Verified: the kept-only variant of this map reproduces the legacy bg8 ANNOTATIONS for all 2750 patches (0 mismatches); void covers 92,145 px (0.20% of pixels, 0.25% of Background).
